description: Read and filter the system log from a MikroTik router. Supports filtering by topic, message prefix, and a time window (last N minutes) measured against the router's own clock. Entries with unparseable timestamps are included conservatively.

prefix.description: Substring to match against the log message

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

sinceMinutes.description: Only return entries from the last N minutes (1–1440), measured against the router's clock

topics.description: Filter entries whose topics field contains any of these strings (e.g. ["firewall", "dhcp"])

name: get_log
title: Get Log
